import numpy as np

# Data for Jan, Feb, Mar 1941 (in thousands of tons)
american = np.array([468, 489, 553])
grand_total = np.array([1825, 1801, 2032])

sum_total = np.sum(grand_total)

print(f"Sum of Grand total: {sum_total}")

print(f"March: {mar_pct:.2f}%")

python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Data for Jan, Feb, Mar 1941 (in thousands of tons)
american = [468, 489, 553]
grand_total = [1825, 1801, 2032]

# Calculate percentage of American vessels to total
sum_american = sum(american)
sum_total = sum(grand_total)
percentage = (sum_american / sum_total) * 100

print(f"Sum of American vessels: {sum_american}")
print(f"Sum of Grand total: {sum_total}")
print(f"Percentage: {percentage}")
print(f"Percentage rounded to 1 decimal: {round(percentage, 1)}")

# Calculate Pearson correlation coefficient manually
n = len(american)
mean_am = sum(american) / n
mean_gt = sum(grand_total) / n

# Calculate covariance
cov = sum((american[i] - mean_am) * (grand_total[i] - mean_gt) for i in range(n)) / n

# Calculate standard deviations
std_am = math.sqrt(sum((x - mean_am)**2 for x in american) / n)
std_gt = math.sqrt(sum((x - mean_gt)**2 for x in grand_total) / n)

# Calculate correlation
correlation = cov / (std_am * std_gt)

print(f"\nPearson correlation coefficient: {correlation}")
print(f"Correlation rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(correlation, 3)}")

# Also check individual month percentages
jan_pct = (468/1825)*100
feb_pct = (489/1801)*100
mar_pct = (553/2032)*100
print(f"\nIndividual month percentages:")
print(f"January: {jan_pct:.2f}%")
print(f"February: {feb_pct:.2f}%")
print(f"March: {mar_pct:.2f}%")
print(f"Average of months: {(jan_pct + feb_pct + mar_pct)/3:.2f}%")
EOF
